name: Love Tangle
source:
You are a credited scientist and researcher of wildlife conservation in Kaleido City. Your story begins when you move in to the luxurious apartment called Lilac Court where many celebrities reside. You take a position in a new workplace, Kaleido National Animal Institute, to save endangered species.

Once you’ve moved in, you get to know many handsome and mature residents. Then, two men get close to you and begin to fight over your heart. As your heart wavers, you’ll make a decision to choose one, whom you can chase your dreams together with. Untangle the bittersweet knot of a love triangle, and find your best man!

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/135303047746/lovetangle]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
你是卡莱多市著名的野生动物保护科学家和研究员。当你搬进名为“丁香阁”的豪华公寓时，你的故事就开始了，这里居住着许多名人。你在新的工作场所卡莱多国家动物研究所就职，以拯救濒临灭绝的物种。

一旦你搬进来，你就会认识很多英俊成熟的住户。然后，两个男人靠近你并开始争夺你的心。当你的内心动摇时，你会决定选择一个可以和你一起追逐梦想的人。解开苦乐参半的三角恋结，找到你的最佳伴侣！

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/135303047746/lovetangle]英语乙女游戏[/url]]
